company.name: Casetext
company.shortDescription: Casetext is an AI legal research technology for litigators, helping researchers find cases.
company.description: Casetext has used A.I. legal research technology, that has been adopted across the legal market. Its award-winning technology offers both conventional search functionality and its CARA A.I. powered contextual search, which focuses on the context of research to help find on-point authorities faster. Founded by a team of former litigators from top law firms, as well as Ph.D. data scientists and leading A.I. engineers, Casetext helps legal researchers find the cases, including many that they would otherwise miss.

aiResearchSummary.text: Casetext is researching systems for natural language database generation and query to update databases from legal text, and a text generation interface system and generative text model query system that craft prompts to identify factual assertions and answer questions. It develops hallucination detection and remediation in text generation interface systems and a large language model artificial intelligence text evaluation system for relevance scoring, along with query evaluation and text reduction and analysis interfaces to support structured document generation. These efforts span prompt engineering, relevance modeling, hallucination control, and structured drafting.
